source: Intermediate short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: مرة، جدتي تعبت ورحنا فيها عالمستشفى.
sentences.en: Once, my grandmother got sick and we took her to the hospital.
We were very worried about her.

sentences.ar: الدكتور فحصها وقال إنه ما في خطر.
sentences.en: The doctor examined her and said there was no danger.

sentences.ar: قال إنها بس تعبانة وبدها راحة.
sentences.en: He said she was just tired and needed rest.
We all felt relieved when we heard that.
We sat next to her in the room and talked with her.
After two days, she got better and we took her home.

sentences.ar: طبخنالها أكل خفيف وقعدنا نهتم فيها.
sentences.en: We cooked her light food and took care of her.

sentences.ar: بعد أسبوع، رجعت متل ما كانت.
sentences.en: After a week, she went back to how she was.

sentences.ar: تعلمنا يومها إنه الصحة أغلى شي.
sentences.en: That day we learned that health is the most precious thing.
